description:
Goal
The telemetry arc is complete only when every compiler2/fz2 production emitter passes existing raw semantic authorities and every handler derives or retains presentation data during its callback. With no handler, payload closures are not entered and the concrete NullTelemetry path can be erased.

Proven model failure
The original grammar was local: a helper parameter was trusted as raw even when every caller supplied a count, projection, allocation, or recursively forwarded computation. It also hand-listed lazy APIs and omitted Span::close_with_lazy. The same boundary error survived in the data model as generic type-reference Value/consumer_kind envelopes, TypeName ownership retained only for telemetry, mutation changed mirrors, pull identical history projection, and CodegenFnStats counters maintained only for observation.

Resolution
The production guard builds a same-scan callable graph keyed by callable kind, arity, and impl owner. Scalar helper parameters recursively validate every callsite. A computed local is accepted only when its binding has a proven operational consumer; helper-only and dead-store laundering remain rejected. Borrowed parameters require raw places. The guard inventories every payload-bearing Telemetry, TelemetryExt, and public Span method, recognizes close_with_lazy, and bans eager payload APIs.

World-owned definition events now emit only on actual mutation and carry raw World plus the stable typed key; no changed mirror is emitted. Type-reference publication uses separate function/type event paths with World+FunctionId or World+TypeName, and record_type_def_refs borrows its input while TypeRefMap performs only its required semantic key clone. CodegenFnStats, both reusable-cons profiling counters, their event/JSON projection/capture, pull identical telemetry, and obsolete snapshot comparison helpers are deleted. Semantic reusable-capability and runtime reuse authorities remain.

Signal
Direct, recursive, pre-bound, and dead-store laundering fixtures fail while returned semantic values pass. close_with_lazy descent and sink API inventory are pinned. The full production emitter guard and NullTelemetry no-projection/no-counter probe pass. cargo test --lib passes 1,413 tests with 6 ignored and no failures. cargo fmt --check, workspace/all-target/all-feature check, both strict clippy variants, and cargo build --release --bin fz2 pass. The release fixture fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz emits no diagnostics: no handler is 0.05s real / 0.05s user / 0.02s sys; JSON telemetry is 0.06s / 0.06s / 0.02s and writes 1,055 valid events / 254,760 bytes. The audit-fix diff is net -8 lines, with no added Rust comments, allowances, shadow payload schema, telemetry-only counters, or retained scaffolding.
title: Migrate raw-authority telemetry handlers and audit event payloads
